<!-- One skin per pull request. / Jeden skin na pull request. -->

## New skin / Nový skin

- Skin file: `skins/<kebab-case-name>.json`

### Checklist

- [ ] The PR adds or changes **one** file in `skins/` and nothing else
      (CI enforces this for external PRs).
- [ ] `node scripts/validate-all.mjs` passes locally.
- [ ] **I agree to release this skin under CC0-1.0** (credit stays in the
      `author` field). / Souhlasím s vydáním pod CC0-1.0.

> Note: code contributions (editor, validator, workflows) are handled by the
> maintainers — see the app repository's CONTRIBUTING for the project's
> closed-contribution policy. Skin PRs are welcome!
